title: The Daily Grind – Toffee Nut Latte 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – Toffee Nut Latte 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
Daily Grind Toffee Nut Latte – A Sweet and moreish toffee treat, filled with nutty, wholesome hazelnuts and topped with a splash of warm milk.
Primary Flavours
: Toffee, Hazelnut, Coffee, Milk
PG/VG Ratio:
70 VG / 30 PG
Bottle Sizes:
100ml
Nicotine:
0 MG
